title: Implement JSON output formatting helpers
description: Implement JSON output formatting helpers for consistent, pretty-printed responses. Support indentation, field selection, and filtering. Ensure JSON is valid and LLM-friendly. Provide both compact and pretty formats.
acceptance_criteria: 1. JSON formatter with indentation options 2. Field selection support via --include flag 3. Compact mode (no whitespace) 4. Pretty mode with 2-space indent 5. Validation of JSON output

title: Implement error handling and retry patterns
description: Implement comprehensive error handling and retry patterns. Define error types for API errors, rate limits, authentication failures, and parsing errors. Provide helpful error messages with recovery suggestions. Integrate with retry logic.
acceptance_criteria: 1. Error types: APIError, RateLimitError, AuthError, ParseError 2. Wrap errors with context 3. User-friendly error messages 4. Retry logic for transient errors 5. Error code to message mapping

title: Implement image export API client
description: Implement Figma image export API client to render nodes as images. Support PNG, JPG, SVG, and PDF formats with scale options. Handle multiple node IDs in single request for efficiency. Manage export URLs and expiration.
acceptance_criteria: 1. ExportImages(fileKey, ids, format, scale) implemented 2. Supports: PNG, JPG, SVG, PDF formats 3. Scale parameter: 1, 2, or 3x 4. Batch export for multiple IDs 5. URL expiration handling

title: Implement figma typography command
description: Implement figma typography command to extract typography styles from designs. Parse font families, sizes, weights, line heights, and letter spacing. Return type scale and font usage stats. Support text node filtering and style grouping.
acceptance_criteria: 1. figma typography <file_key> --node-id <id> extracts fonts 2. Returns: fontFamily, fontSize, fontWeight, lineHeight 3. Type scale with common sizes 4. Font usage statistics 5. Output in structured JSON format

title: Implement authentication (PAT and OAuth 2.0 support)
description: Implement authentication for Figma API supporting both Personal Access Tokens (PAT) and OAuth 2.0. Store tokens securely in keychain/env. Handle token refresh for OAuth. Provide authentication commands for token management.
acceptance_criteria: 1. PAT authentication via X-Figma-Token header 2. OAuth 2.0 flow with PKCE 3. Token storage in system keychain or env vars 4. Token refresh for expired OAuth tokens 5. Commands: figma config --token, figma auth login

title: Implement node operations API client
description: Implement Figma node operations API client. Add methods for getting specific nodes, node batches, and node queries. Support depth parameter and filtering. Efficiently handle node-only requests to reduce payload size.
acceptance_criteria: 1. GetNode(fileKey, nodeId) returns single node 2. GetNodes(fileKey, nodeIds) for batch requests 3. Depth parameter support (1-10) 4. Geometry parameter for minimal responses 5. Unit tests for various node types

title: Initialize Go project structure and directories
description: Initialize Go project structure with standard directories (cmd, pkg, internal, .beads). Create go.mod file, directory layout, and README with project overview. This establishes the foundation for all subsequent development.
acceptance_criteria: 1. go.mod created with correct module name 2. Standard directories created: cmd/, pkg/, internal/ 3. .beads/ directory exists for bead tracking 4. README.md with project description and getting started guide

title: Implement figma export command
description: Implement figma export command to export nodes as SVG, PNG, JPG, or PDF files. Support format selection, scale (1x, 2x, 3x), and output directory. Handle large exports with progress indication. Useful for asset extraction.
acceptance_criteria: 1. figma export <url> --format svg works 2. Supports: svg, png, jpg, pdf formats 3. --scale 1/2/3 for resolution 4. --output <dir> for custom location 5. Progress indicator for large exports

title: Implement figma typography command
description: Implement the 'figma typography' command to extract typography styles from a Figma node, including font families, sizes, weights, and line heights.
acceptance_criteria:
1. 'figma typography <file_key> --node-id <id>' returns typography styles JSON
2. Extracts text styles from text nodes
3. Groups similar typography styles
4. Output includes fontFamily, fontSize, fontWeight, lineHeight
5. Output matches design document example

title: Implement figma instances command
description: Implement figma instances command to find all instances of a component. Given a component key or instance, locate all usages across the file. Return instance IDs, parent frames, and override values. Useful for design system audit.
acceptance_criteria: 1. figma instances <file_key> <component_key> works 2. Returns all instances with IDs and locations 3. Shows override values per instance 4. Parent frame context included 5. Counts total instances

title: Implement figma list command for node enumeration
description: Implement figma list command to enumerate nodes by type within a file. Support filtering by type (FRAME, TEXT, COMPONENT), name patterns, and limiting results. Return nodes with IDs, names, and URLs for easy access.
acceptance_criteria: 1. figma list <file_key> --type <type> works 2. Returns nodes with: id, name, type, url 3. --name '*pattern*' filter supported 4. Result count displayed 5. Pagination support for large results

title: Implement figma component command
description: Implement figma component command to get component definitions. For a component instance, resolve to component definition. For a component, return its properties, variants, and default values. Support instance vs component mode.
acceptance_criteria: 1. figma component <url> returns component info 2. Resolves instances to definitions 3. Shows component properties and defaults 4. Lists variants (if component set) 5. Output in structured JSON

title: Configure code quality tools (golangci-lint, gofmt)
description: Configure code quality tools: golangci-lint for linting, gofmt for formatting. Create .golangci.yml config and pre-commit hooks. Set up CI checks to ensure code quality standards are maintained.
acceptance_criteria: 1. golangci-lint installed and configured 2. .golangci.yml with project rules 3. Pre-commit hooks for gofmt and linting 4. CI pipeline runs linters on PRs 5. CI fails on lint errors

title: Implement figma similar command
description: Implement the 'figma similar' command to find similar nodes in the file based on properties like type, size, style, etc.
acceptance_criteria:
1. 'figma similar <url>' returns list of similar nodes
2. Similarity based on type, size, style, component usage
3. Output includes similarity score and node details
4. Configurable similarity threshold
5. Output format configurable (json, table)

title: Implement figma batch command
description: Implement the 'figma batch' command to execute multiple commands from a file, useful for automation and scripting.
acceptance_criteria:
1. 'figma batch <file_path>' executes commands line by line
2. Supports all figma commands in batch file
3. Provides summary of successes and failures
4. Supports continue-on-error flag
5. Output aggregated results in JSON

title: Implement rate limiting with Figma tier awareness
description: Implement rate limiting with Figma tier awareness (Tier 1, 2, 3). Track per-minute/per-month limits based on user seat type and plan. Respect Retry-After headers. Provide warning when approaching limits. This prevents API throttling and account issues.
acceptance_criteria: 1. Rate limiter with tier-specific limits 2. Per-minute and per-month tracking 3. Respect Retry-After header on 429 4. Warning at 80% of limit 5. Configurable backoff duration

title: Implement color and formatting utilities for CLI
description: Implement color and formatting utilities for CLI. Add color conversion functions (hex to rgba, rgb to hsl), formatting helpers (text wrapping, table formatting), and terminal color support. Provide consistent visual output across commands.
acceptance_criteria: 1. Color conversion: hex<->rgba<->hsl 2. Table formatting for structured data 3. Text wrapping for long content 4. Terminal color support 5. Consistent output helpers

title: Implement figma diff command
description: Implement the 'figma diff' command to compare two designs (nodes) and identify changes in text content, colors, properties, etc.
acceptance_criteria:
1. 'figma diff <url1> <url2>' returns changes between nodes
2. Detects text content changes, color changes, property changes
3. Output includes change type, old/new values, node IDs
4. Supports diff within same file or across files
5. Output matches design document example

title: Implement figma batch command
description: Implement figma batch command to execute multiple commands from a file. Parse commands file, execute sequentially, and aggregate results. Support error handling per command and continue-on-error mode. Useful for automation workflows.
acceptance_criteria: 1. figma batch <file> executes commands 2. Parses commands from text/json file 3. Executes commands sequentially 4. Aggregates results and errors 5. --continue-on-error flag

title: Implement figma parse utility command
description: Implement figma parse utility command to extract and display URL components from Figma URLs. Parse and show file key, node ID, file name, version, and timestamp. Useful for debugging and understanding URL structure.
acceptance_criteria: 1. figma parse <url> command defined 2. Output JSON with: fileKey, nodeId, fileName, version, timestamp 3. Support design URLs with node-id parameter 4. Validate URL format 5. Helpful error for invalid URLs

title: Implement figma props command for node properties
description: Implement figma props command to display all node properties including position, size, constraints, rotation, and layout settings. Output in JSON format with detailed property values. Support filtering to show specific property groups.
acceptance_criteria: 1. figma props <url> command defined 2. Returns: x, y, width, height, rotation, constraints 3. Layout properties included 4. Transform matrix values 5. Filterable output via flags

title: Implement Figma URL parsing utilities
description: Implement Figma URL parsing utilities to extract file key, node ID, version, and timestamp from Figma URLs. Support both design and prototype URLs. Validate URL format and provide helpful error messages for invalid URLs.
acceptance_criteria: 1. ParseURL() returns fileKey, nodeId, version 2. Support: design, prototype URLs 3. Extract query parameters 4. URL validation with clear errors 5. Unit tests for various URL formats

title: Design Figma API client architecture and interfaces
description: Design Figma API client architecture with clear interfaces. Define Client interface with methods for files, nodes, images, etc. Separate concerns: HTTP transport, authentication, rate limiting, caching. This provides a clean architecture for API interactions.
acceptance_criteria: 1. Client interface defined with all required methods 2. Separate packages: transport, auth, ratelimit, cache 3. Dependency injection design for testability 4. Architecture diagram in docs/

title: Implement figma text command with recursive support
description: Implement figma text command to extract text content from nodes. Support recursive mode to get text from all child nodes. Output in plain text, JSON, or CSV format. Handle text nodes, frame names, and component names.
acceptance_criteria: 1. figma text <url> extracts node text 2. --recursive flag gets all descendant text 3. --format plain/json/csv supported 4. Handles TEXT, FRAME, COMPONENT node types 5. Proper output format selection

title: Implement figma similar command
description: Implement figma similar command to find nodes with similar properties. Compare dimensions, colors, and styles to find matching nodes. Useful for discovering duplicate components and design inconsistencies.
acceptance_criteria: 1. figma similar <url> finds similar nodes 2. Compares: size, colors, styles 3. Returns similarity score 4. Lists matches with IDs and URLs 5. Configurable similarity threshold

title: Implement figma get command with URL parsing
description: Implement figma get command that accepts Figma URLs and fetches node data. Parse URL to extract file key and node ID, call appropriate API, and output node information. Support --depth parameter for children and --output format.
acceptance_criteria: 1. figma get <url> fetches node data 2. URL parsing integration works 3. --depth parameter controls children returned 4. --output json/yaml/pretty supported 5. Shows parent and immediate children

title: Define Go structs for Figma API response models
description: Define Go structs matching Figma API response models based on OpenAPI spec. Create types for Node, Document, File, Component, Style, Variable, etc. Ensure proper JSON tags and nested structures. This enables type-safe API responses.
acceptance_criteria: 1. Core types defined: Node, Document, File, Frame, Text, Component 2. All Figma node types covered 3. JSON tags for all fields 4. Unit tests for serialization/deserialization

title: Implement figma styles command
description: Implement figma styles command to get styles applied to a node. Return text styles, fill styles, effect styles, and grid styles. Show style references and their definitions. Support both applied and referenced styles.
acceptance_criteria: 1. figma styles <url> returns node styles 2. Text style: font, size, weight, color 3. Fill style: colors, gradients, images 4. Effect style: shadows, blurs 5. Style references resolved

title: Implement figma search command by text/type/name
description: Implement figma search command with multiple search modes: text content, node type, and name pattern. Support case-sensitive and exact matching. Return matching nodes with context and URLs. Enable discovery of content across files.
acceptance_criteria: 1. figma search <file_key> <query> works 2. --type filter for node types 3. --name pattern matching 4. --case-sensitive and --exact flags 5. Results with IDs, names, URLs

title: Set up project configuration (dotenv, config files)
description: Set up project configuration management supporting .env files, JSON config, and CLI arguments. Define config structure for tokens, output format, export directories, and API settings. Load configuration from multiple sources with precedence.
acceptance_criteria: 1. Config struct with all settings 2. Load from .env, ~/.config/figma/config.json 3. CLI flags override config 4. Support: token, output format, export dir 5. Config validation and defaults

title: Implement figma screenshot command
description: Implement the 'figma screenshot' command to get a visual preview URL of a Figma node (returns image URL for quick viewing).
acceptance_criteria:
1. 'figma screenshot <url>' returns image URL of the node
2. URL is accessible and displays the node preview
3. Supports --scale flag for higher resolution
4. Output can be JSON or plain URL
5. Handles nodes that cannot be screenshot gracefully

title: Implement HTTP client with exponential backoff retry
description: Implement HTTP client with exponential backoff retry logic for Figma API requests. Handle rate limits (429), transient errors, and network failures. Implement jitter and max retry limits. This ensures reliable API communication.
acceptance_criteria: 1. HTTP client with configurable timeout 2. Exponential backoff with jitter 3. Retry on 429, 5xx, network errors 4. Max 5 retries per request 5. Unit tests for retry scenarios

title: Configure GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline
description: Configure GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline. Set up workflows for running tests, linting, and building releases. Automate tag-based releases and artifact generation. Ensure all PRs are validated before merge.
acceptance_criteria: 1. .github/workflows/ with CI/CD jobs 2. Test workflow on all PRs 3. Lint workflow in CI pipeline 4. Release workflow for tags 5. Artifact generation for binaries

title: Implement configuration management commands
description: Implement configuration management commands: figma config --token, --show, --output. Allow setting and viewing configuration values. Support setting tokens, output format preferences, and export directories. Persist changes to config file.
acceptance_criteria: 1. figma config --token <token> sets token 2. figma config --show displays current config 3. figma config --output json/yaml sets format 4. figma config --export-dir <path> sets directory 5. Config persists to ~/.config/figma/config.json

title: Implement figma tree command for structure
description: Implement figma tree command to display complete node hierarchy from a starting point. Support max-depth parameter and filtering by node type. Display as indented ASCII tree or JSON structure. Useful for understanding file organization.
acceptance_criteria: 1. figma tree <file_key> --node-id <id> works 2. --max-depth parameter limits tree depth 3. --type filter (FRAME, COMPONENT, etc.) 4. ASCII tree output format 5. JSON output option

title: Set up Cobra CLI framework and command structure
description: Set up Cobra CLI framework for command structure. Define root command, command tree, and persistent flags. Create command registration system and help generation. This provides the foundation for all CLI commands and user interaction.
acceptance_criteria: 1. Root command 'figma' defined with help and version subcommands 2. Command registration pattern established 3. Global flags: --token, --output, --debug 4. Help text and usage examples for each command

title: Implement figma colors command
description: Implement figma colors command to extract color palette from designs. Parse fills, strokes, and text colors. Return hex, rgba, and color names. Support recursive extraction and color grouping. Useful for design system documentation and theme generation.
acceptance_criteria: 1. figma colors <file_key> --node-id <id> extracts colors 2. Returns: hex, rgba, color names 3. Recursive mode for all descendant colors 4. Color palette with primary/secondary grouping 5. Output in structured JSON format

title: Set up Go modules and dependency management
description: Set up Go modules configuration and dependency management. Initialize go.mod, define required dependencies (cobra, http client, logging), and create scripts for dependency management. This ensures proper Go toolchain setup and version control of dependencies.
acceptance_criteria: 1. go.mod initialized with module name github.com/user/figma-cli 2. go.sum created 3. Dependencies added: cobra, go-homedir, envconfig 4. Makefile with install/clean targets

title: Implement figma export command
description: Implement the 'figma export' command to export Figma nodes as SVG, PNG, JPG, or PDF files with scale control and output directory options.
acceptance_criteria:
1. 'figma export <url> --format <format>' exports node as image/file
2. Supports formats: svg, png, jpg, pdf
3. Supports --scale flag (1, 2, 3)
4. Supports --output directory flag
5. Handles async export polling and downloads files
6. Output matches design document example

title: Implement figma colors command
description: Implement the 'figma colors' command to extract color palette from a Figma node, including named colors and palette summary.
acceptance_criteria:
1. 'figma colors <file_key> --node-id <id>' returns color palette JSON
2. Extracts colors from fills, strokes, effects
3. Groups similar colors and assigns names where possible
4. Output includes hex, rgba, and palette summary
5. Output matches design document example

title: Implement figma diff command
description: Implement figma diff command to compare two designs or nodes. Detect changes in text content, colors, properties, and structure. Return detailed diff with before/after values. Support cross-file and same-file comparisons.
acceptance_criteria: 1. figma diff <url1> <url2> compares designs 2. Detects: text, color, property changes 3. Shows before/after values 4. Works across different files 5. Summary of total changes

title: Implement figma context command for hierarchy
description: Implement figma context command to display node hierarchy and relationships. Show ancestors, siblings, and children in tree format. Support --ancestors, --siblings, --children flags for customization. Help users understand node structure.
acceptance_criteria: 1. figma context <url> shows hierarchy tree 2. --ancestors N shows N parent levels 3. --siblings shows nodes at same level 4. --children N shows N child levels 5. Highlights current node in tree

title: Implement figma spec command for design specs
description: Implement figma spec command to extract comprehensive design specifications from nodes. Output colors, typography, spacing, border radius, shadows, and layout constraints in structured JSON format. Support recursive extraction from containers.
acceptance_criteria: 1. figma spec <url> extracts design specs 2. Color palette with hex/rgba values 3. Typography (font family, size, weight, line height) 4. Spacing (padding, margin, gaps) 5. Output in structured JSON

title: Set up testing framework and test helpers
description: Set up testing framework with test helpers and mocks. Create test suite structure, table-driven tests for commands, and mock API client for testing. Define test data fixtures for Figma API responses.
acceptance_criteria: 1. Test suite structure established 2. Mock API client for unit tests 3. Table-driven test examples 4. Test fixtures in testdata/ directory 5. CI runs tests with coverage

title: Implement figma overview command for file summary
description: Implement figma overview command to get file summary statistics. Count nodes by type, pages, components, styles, and total nodes. Show file metadata and last modified. Provide quick file health overview.
acceptance_criteria: 1. figma overview <file_key> shows file summary 2. Returns: page count, frame count, component count 3. Text node count and total node count 4. File metadata: name, lastModified, version 5. Pages list with node counts

title: Implement file operations API client
description: Implement Figma file operations API client. Add methods for getting files, file metadata, versions, and file lists. Support file_key queries and branch support. Handle large file responses efficiently.
acceptance_criteria: 1. GetFile(fileKey) returns complete Document 2. GetFileMetadata(fileKey) returns file metadata 3. GetFileVersions(fileKey) with pagination 4. Branch parameter support 5. Error handling for missing files

title: Implement structured logging infrastructure
description: Implement structured logging infrastructure using a Go logging library (zap or logrus). Support log levels (debug, info, warn, error), log formats (JSON, text), and file rotation. Ensure all API calls and errors are logged.
acceptance_criteria: 1. Logger interface with context support 2. Configurable log level and format 3. Structured logging with request IDs 4. API request/response logging 5. File rotation for debug logs

title: Implement figma screenshot command
description: Implement figma screenshot command to get visual preview URLs of nodes. Return image URLs from Figma's image export API. Support multiple formats and resolution options. Provide clickable URLs for quick access.
acceptance_criteria: 1. figma screenshot <url> returns image URL 2. Supports: png, jpg, svg formats 3. Resolution/scale options 4. URL is clickable 5. Handles expiration/refresh logic
